<thought>To obtain real template IDs I will query the template catalog for each required transformation using representative product SMILES and the functional groups that are formed (and, when possible, broken). I will start with the sulfonamide formation step.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(Nc1ccccc1)C",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
